verify_kyc_mtn.description: Security & KYC Verification: Verify registered subscriber KYC details and account name on MTN Mobile Money for a phone number before confirming transfer

send_money_mtn.description: Trigger an MTN Ghana Mobile Money transfer once recipient number, network, amount, reference, registered KYC name, and explicit confirmation are all verified

check_balance_mtn.description: Trigger MTN Mobile Money balance enquiry guidance for caller number

cash_out_mtn.description: Initiate an MTN Mobile Money withdrawal / cash out guidance once confirmed
